g.text: py-app-sticker-terminal-druk-3-seconden | type sticker | trim 56.44 x 21.31 mm, bleed 3 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: 22 printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: TerminalStickers_September2026.pdf p1 (CMYK; bleed box in bron nee). Template: trim 56.44 x 21.31 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 62.44 x 27.31 mm.
Variabelen: text-nl = Druk 3 seconden; text-en = Press 3 seconds

Snijcontour: groep cut-contour, spot ThruCut, 1 pt, 0.2 mm binnen de trim. Proposal: the source has only a 0.25 pt hairline as die line, no ThruCut contour. Radius measured on the die line, to be confirmed by the printer.

White sticker, navy text centred, two lines: 'Druk 3 seconden' bold and 'Press 3 seconds' italic. The source outlines the text; the template sets it as live Ubuntu (bold 5.96 mm with slight negative tracking, medium italic 5.96 mm) fitted to the outlined glyphs. The sheet holds the sticker twice, identical. Sheet TerminalStickers_September2026.pdf (271

x 391 mm, no bleed, no trim marks): a hairline die line (black, 0.25 to 0.74 pt) around each white sticker. The template replaces that line by a ThruCut contour 0.2 mm inside the trim and adds a 3 mm bleed. Source blue CMYK 99.5/85/21.4/6.8 (drift, see tokens.json observed): the template uses the token blue.
